stations.title: Your functions

stations.title: Year report
stations.text: Hours for the year, added up by the laptop.

captions: At the base, Rhona asks how many hours the team spent on the hill this year.
Today the book is one long text, so the hours get added up on the back of an envelope.
You split the book into lines and parts, take out the numbers and join lines back up.
Now the hours come out of the book added up, the same every time.
The year's hours come out of the book added up, and each hill is spelt one way.
